description: This PHP source file defines the ShippingAddress controller class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages the checkout shipping address page, including displaying existing addresses, saving new addresses, and selecting an address for shipping. The class handles validation, session management, and interaction with address and custom field models.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: Controller class for managing the checkout shipping address page, including display, save, and address selection functions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the shipping address page, loading addresses, custom fields, and generating view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of a new or updated shipping address, performs validation, updates session data, and clears related session variables.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Handles setting an existing address as the shipping address, validating cart and session state, and updating session data.
